title: ContextPromotion
description: HS-200-10: one promotion of one Interview fact into one canonical record. The quote is a LOCATOR and a HASH, never a copy, so revoking the source removes the words while provenance stays provable. This kind rides the wire so the retrieval fence travels with the record: a device that receives a promoted note without its promotion re-admits the body to its own relevance corpus. A promotion is never tombstoned -- `deleted` is always false -- because a tombstone would be an un-revoke by another name, and `revoked` beats `active` in a merge regardless of clock.
